theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  classical
  
  let f : ℕ → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have h₂ : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
    have h₃ : Set.range f ⊆ Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T) := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩
      have := hB n; have := hB (n + 1); have := hB (n + 2); have := hB (n + 3)
      simp only at * ⊢; tauto
    exact Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T))) h₃
  
  have h₃ : ∃ (i j : ℕ), i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! h₄
    have h₅ : Function.Injective f := by
      intro i j h₆
      by_cases h₇ : i = j
      · exact h₇
      · cases lt_or_gt_of_ne h₇ with
        | inl h₈ => exact (h₄ i j h₈ h₆).elim
        | inr h₈ => exact (h₄ j i h₈ (by simp [h₆])).elim
    exact Set.not_infinite.mpr h₂ (Set.infinite_range_of_injective h₅)
  
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ := h₃
  have h₁ : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      match m with
      | 0 => exact h_eq.1
      | 1 => exact h_eq.2.1
      | 2 => exact h_eq.2.2.1
      | 3 => exact h_eq.2.2.2
      | m + 4 =>
        have h₄ : i + m + 4 ≥ 4 := by omega
        have h₅ : j + m + 4 ≥ 4 := by omega
        have h₆ := hu (i + m + 4) h₄
        have h₇ := hu (j + m + 4) h₅
        have h₈ : (i + m + 4 - 1 : ℕ) = i + m + 3 := by omega
        have h₉ : (i + m + 4 - 2 : ℕ) = i + m + 2 := by omega
        have h₁₀ : (i + m + 4 - 3 : ℕ) = i + m + 1 := by omega
        have h₁₁ : (i + m + 4 - 4 : ℕ) = i + m := by omega
        have h₁₂ : (j + m + 4 - 1 : ℕ) = j + m + 3 := by omega
        have h₁₃ : (j + m + 4 - 2 : ℕ) = j + m + 2 := by omega
        have h₁₄ : (j + m + 4 - 3 : ℕ) = j + m + 1 := by omega
        have h₁₅ : (j + m + 4 - 4 : ℕ) = j + m := by omega
        have h₁₆ : u (i + m + 3) = u (j + m + 3) := ih (m + 3) (by omega)
        have h₁₇ : u (i + m + 2) = u (j + m + 2) := ih (m + 2) (by omega)
        have h₁₈ : u (i + m + 1) = u (j + m + 1) := ih (m + 1) (by omega)
        have h₁₉ : u (i + m) = u (j + m) := ih m (by omega)
        norm_cast at h₆ h₇ h₁₆ h₁₇ h₁₈ h₁₉ ⊢
        simp [h₈, h₉, h₁₀, h₁₁, h₁₂, h₁₃, h₁₄, h₁₅, h₁₆, h₁₇, h₁₈, h₁₉] at h₆ h₇ ⊢
        <;> simp_all
        <;> norm_cast
  
  use i, j - i
  constructor
  · omega
  · intro n hn
    have h₅ : u (i + (n - i)) = u (j + (n - i)) := h₁ (n - i)
    have h₆ : i + (n - i) = n := by omega
    have h₇ : j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) := by omega
    rw [h₆, h₇] at h₅
    exact h₅.symm
